## Testing Mode
RED

## Context
Story 2f51 verifier P1=FAIL on the per-leaf DirectionMismatchError DD:
production code (_direction_guard) is correctly wired on all 12 leaves,
but test coverage is 1-of-12 (only _apply_inbound_clean_label is tested).
This task closes the coverage gap.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_direction_guard.py exists
- [ ] Test is parametrized over every (direction, action) pair in
      applier._LEAVES; each parametrize case constructs a Mutation with
      the leaf's expected direction, flips direction to the opposite via
      object.__setattr__ (frozen dataclass), invokes the leaf, asserts
      DirectionMismatchError is raised
- [ ] 12 cases pass (the 12 entries currently in _LEAVES)
- [ ] Lint clean: ruff check tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_direction_guard.py
- [ ] No production code changes (production _direction_guard is already correct)

## File Impact
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_applier_direction_guard.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
